content: Figure FIGREF34 shows the workflow of building DNN models in NeuronBlocks. Users only need to write a JSON configuration file. They can either instantiate an existing template from Model Zoo, or construct a new architecture based on the blocks from Block Zoo. This configuration file is shared across training, test, and prediction. For model hyper-parameter tuning or architecture modification, users just need to change the JSON configuration file. Advanced users can also contribute novel customized blocks into Block Zoo, as long as they follow the same interface guidelines with the existing blocks. These new blocks can be further shared across all users for model architecture design. Moreover, NeuronBlocks has flexible platform support, such as GPU/CPU, GPU management platforms like PAI.
